customManagers.description: ClamAV CLI release pinned in mdm/clamav/versions.env. The 'clamav-' tag prefix is deliberately OUTSIDE the capture group so Renovate writes back a correctly formatted tag; extractVersionTemplate makes the upstream tags comparable to the bare version we captured.
ClamAV GUI release pinned in mdm/clamav/versions.env. Same prefix-outside-the-group rule as above. Prereleases such as v1.0.7-1 parse as semver prereleases and are skipped by ignoreUnstable.

packageRules.description: The sha256 pins in versions.env go stale the moment a tag changes. CI recomputes them (see .github/workflows/pr.yml), so these must land as reviewable PRs and never automerge.
